description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage insurtech team building AI systems to automate commercial insurance workflows. You will work directly with the founder and own core platform capabilities, helping businesses find suitable coverage more efficiently.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build browser-use agents for automated insurance workflows.

 - Develop voice AI for interactions with clients and insurance carriers.

 - Create long-horizon LLM pipelines and robust evaluation frameworks.

 - Build carrier integrations and AI-powered quoting and submission pipelines.

 - Develop AI agents for policy analysis and document processing.

 - Take ownership of end-to-end systems across a broad range of platform needs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 0 to 5 years of software engineering experience, or recent graduation with a completed degree.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including systems design, clean code, and debugging.

 - Hands-on experience building production LLM, AI agent, or voice AI systems, including evaluation frameworks.

 - Experience building from 0 to 1 in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

 - Working knowledge of Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, or related agent frameworks; browser-use agent experience is relevant.

 - A CS or engineering degree and experience in an early-stage startup or established technology company.

 - Background in insurtech, fintech, or healthcare technology is a plus.

 - Must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $150,000 to $235,000 annually, depending on experience, plus meaningful founding-team equity. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco.
